context.primaryDevice: PS5 browser on a TV, DualSense from the couch
context.engine: WebKit at Safari 17 level; no backdrop-filter; no Gamepad API
context.delivery: one self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JS; no external fonts, images or requests; under 700 KB

display.purpose: The focused game's title on the home screen; two lines maximum, always shown whole. Line-height 1.12 with a 0.04em bottom pad. On the TV layout the size is fitted: from 5rem (4rem over 16 characters) down to a 2rem floor until the title and the Library fit.

headline.purpose: Section page titles; dialog titles at 1.75rem; wordmark at 1.5rem with -0.01em tracking.

title.purpose: Facts line, shelf heading, drive names.

subtitle.purpose: Block headings, list-row titles, shelf-cover names (1.0625rem).

body-lg.purpose: State sentence (two lines maximum) and hero action labels.

label.purpose: Stage labels, status line, metadata, hints, legend, small buttons; stage notes on the same line as the label, after a middle dot. The couch-distance floor.

tag.purpose: Error codes on covers with tabular numerals; inline tags at 0.8125rem.

path.purpose: Platform monospace for filesystem paths, job routes and the log view only.

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Second border on the selected shelf cover. A spread ring with no offset or blur; the system has no drop shadows.

focus.name: focus-tab
focus.purpose: Section tabs; drawn inside the tab.

scrims.name: scrim-home
scrims.purpose: Home screen over landscape key art: top band, bottom band, reading-side band. Mirrored for right-to-left.

scrims.name: scrim-cover-mode
scrims.value: reading-side band becomes solid #0b0b0c to 40%, rgba(11,11,12,.78) at 56%, transparent at 80%
scrims.purpose: When only portrait cover art exists; the cover sits at the far side at 72% brightness.

scrims.name: scrim-section
scrims.purpose: Uniform veil on every non-home view.

scrims.name: grain
scrims.value: SVG fractal-noise data URI, 160px tile, opacity .07
scrims.purpose: Dithers the stacked gradients so they do not band.

motion.name: focus-and-crossfade
motion.purpose: Art-layer opacity cross-fade, shelf-cover scale to 1.06, stage-tracker re-stamp (opacity .35 to 1). Nothing else animates; hover and switches change instantly.

libraryFit.purpose: Outside the reflow layout the Library never scrolls. Each title size is tried with full-size covers, then compact covers, until nothing overflows and the title shows in full; a larger title wins over full-size covers. The shelf keeps 0.5rem above the legend.

breakpoints.name: job-strip-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Job-strip meter shrinks to 3rem; secondary figures drop; shelf filter narrows to 10rem.

breakpoints.name: job-strip-no-meter
breakpoints.purpose: Job-strip meter drops; the percentage or state word carries progress alone.

components.name: Button
components.description: The default control: outlined rectangle over a translucent near-black fill, optional line icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg class="ds-i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7h10M18 7h2M4 17h4M12 17h8"/><rect x="14" y="5" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="8" y="15" width="4" height="4"/></svg>Configure</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(12,12,14,.62); color: #fff; font: 400 18px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.16); } .ds-btn:focus, .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.16); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; } .ds-i { width: 1.25em; height: 1.25em; margin-right: 10px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid white with black bold text. One per screen or dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 136px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #000; font: 700 20px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e9e9e9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-i-p { width: 1.25em; height: 1.25em; margin-right: 10px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Delete Confirmation Button
components.description: Solid red; only the final, irreversible delete step. Every earlier destructive step is an ordinary outlined button.
components.css: .ds-btn-delete { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #c62828; border-radius: 6px; background: #c62828; color: #fff; font: 700 18px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-delete:focus, .ds-btn-delete:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Text tabs in the top bar; the selected tab is bold with a 3px white underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; margin: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: rgba(255,255,255,.84); font: 400 18px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 3px; height: 3px; background: #fff; } .ds-tab:focus, .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: -3px; color: #fff; }

components.name: Stage Tracker
components.description: Five stages stating how far a game got, each a mark and a word on one line with no box: done (white check), deferred 'on launch' (play triangle), in progress (progress glyph), not reached, not needed and not observed (dim dash, with a 'Not observed' note where it applies; never red, never a check), and failed, the only filled mark (a red square with a white cross). State is carried by glyph, label and note together. The same marks lead the launch-record stage list in the diagnostics dialog.
components.html:
1. Found
  2. Prepared
  3. Mounted
  4. Registered
  5. RunningNot observed
components.css: .ds-tracker { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font: 400 16px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-stage { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; margin-right: 24px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-seg { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 3px; color: #fff; } .ds-seg svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-failed .ds-seg { background: #c62828; } .ds-failed .ds-seg svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; stroke-width: 3; } .ds-none .ds-seg { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); } .ds-stage-label { color: rgba(255,255,255,.84); } .ds-done .ds-stage-label, .ds-failed .ds-stage-label { color: #fff; } .ds-stage-note { color: #fff; } .ds-stage-note::before { content: "\00B7"; margin: 0 6px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); }

components.name: Shelf Cover
components.description: One game on the cover shelf: 16:9 art over a caption, 15rem wide (13rem when the Library compacts). The selected cover is framed, ringed and enlarged from its bottom edge. A failed cover carries a cross word and a red code tag; a not-observed cover carries a neutral word only.
components.css: .ds-shelf { display: flex; padding: 16px 8px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-card { position: relative; flex: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 240px; margin-right: 16px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34); border-radius: 6px; background: #151517; color: #fff; text-align: start; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transform-origin: center bottom; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-thumb { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #1d1d20; } .ds-initials { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); } .ds-cap { height: 68px; padding: 6px 14px 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; } .ds-name { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-word { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.84); } .ds-failed .ds-word { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-code { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #c62828; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #fff; } .ds-card.ds-selected { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff; transform: scale(1.06); z-index: 2; } .ds-card:focus, .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Opaque field with a white outline; used for filters, paths and numeric settings.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius: 6px; background: #151517; color: #fff; caret-color: #fff; font: 400 18px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Rectangular toggle with a square thumb that jumps sides without animation; the whole row is the target.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 48px; gap: 16px; cursor: pointer; color: #fff; font: 400 16px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-track { flex: none; position: relative; width: 52px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius: 4px; background: #151517; } .ds-track::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-track { background: #fff; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-track::after { left: auto; right: 3px; background: #000; } .ds-switch input:focus + .ds-track { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Meter
components.description: Storage and job progress: outlined bar with a solid white fill, always beside a text figure.
components.css: .ds-meter { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(0,0,0,.4); } .ds-meter > span { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; background: #fff; }

narrative.overview:
UniMount is an Operate surface. Its primary device is the PS5's own browser on a TV, driven with a DualSense from the couch; the measured viewport there is 1540×700 at device pixel ratio 1. The focused game's key art fills that whole viewport, a dark scrim makes the left and bottom readable, and everything UniMount itself contributes is white: type, 1px outlines, and one solid white rectangle for the action that matters. Every other game is one step away on a cover shelf along the bottom.

The system is deliberately thin. There is no brand colour, no decorative surface, no illustration and no icon set beyond a handful of stroked line symbols. White is the only interface colour; one red marks failure. Controls are rectangles with small corners, never circles or pills. The game's own artwork is the only imagery, and where a game has none its initials stand in on a flat dark tile.

The technical frame is part of the design, not a footnote to it. The interface is a single self-contained file served by the console (no external fonts, images or requests) and must stay under 700 KB. The console browser is WebKit at Safari 17 level with no `backdrop-filter` and no Gamepad API: the D-pad arrives as arrow keys, cross as a pointer click, circle as Escape. So every state has to read from across the room, focus has to be unmistakable, and nothing may depend on blur, hover or a font download.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed game art under a scrim; interface drawn in white on top of it.
One solid white rectangle per screen for the primary action; everything else is outlined.
A five-stage tracker of marks and words that states launch truth with glyph and word, not hue.
Platform system sans in two weights, tabular numerals for facts and codes.
Sized in rem against a root that scales with the viewport, so the TV layout holds at 1540×700, 1280×720 and 1920×1080.
One 240ms motion, used for focus and the art cross-fade, and nothing else.

rules.name: The One White Rule
rules.body: White is the only interface colour. Emphasis comes from opacity (100, 84, 70 percent), weight and solid-versus-outline, never from a second hue.

rules.name: The Failure Red Rule
rules.body: Red means something failed. It appears only where the console reported a failure, plus the single irreversible-delete confirmation. It is never a brand accent, a hover state or a decoration.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state red or white carries is also carried by shape and words: a check, a play triangle, a progress glyph, a dash or a cross beside each stage's word, a dashed outline for pending meters, a bold status word with a cross on the cover.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 700. No light, medium or black, no italics, no uppercase transforms, no letter-spaced labels. Negative tracking is reserved for the display title and wordmark.

rules.name: The Couch Floor Rule
rules.body: Anything the owner must read from the couch is 1rem or larger. Sizes below that are limited to tags, key caps and the log.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Sizes, counts, timestamps, error codes and progress figures use tabular numerals so they do not jitter as they update.

rules.name: The One Viewport Rule
rules.body: On the TV the home screen fits 1540×700 with nothing below the fold. A new element has to displace something; it cannot extend the page. The title and covers give way first, through the fitting steps; nothing is cut off.

rules.name: The No Blur Rule
rules.body: Never rely on `backdrop-filter`, glass blur or soft shadows for legibility. If text must sit on art, the scrim or an opaque fill does the work.

rules.name: The Rectangle Rule
rules.body: No circles, no pills, no fully rounded ends. The largest radius in the system is 6px.

dos: Do let the focused game's own artwork fill the screen, and use only that artwork as imagery.
Do keep exactly one solid white primary button per screen or dialog; outline the rest.
Do show focus as a 3px solid white outline with an offset, on every focusable element, with no dependence on hover.
Do pair every red or white state with a glyph and a word.
Do size in rem so the layout scales with the root, and check new work at 1540×700 first.
Do keep everything inline: system fonts, inline SVG line symbols, data-URI textures. The file stays self-contained and under 700 KB.
Do mirror every horizontal offset for right-to-left languages, and leave room for long translations (labels do not wrap; containers truncate with an ellipsis).
Do make reduced motion instant: no cross-fade, no scale transition, no re-stamp.
Do show a launch whose end was not observed, or whose outcome is unknown, as "Not observed": a dim dash and a neutral word, never red and never success.
donts: Don't introduce a second interface colour, a tinted surface, or red for anything other than failure and the final delete confirmation.
Don't use circles, pills or radii above 6px, including for toggles, avatars, badges and progress.
Don't use `backdrop-filter`, blur, glow or offset drop shadows; the console cannot render the first and the system does not want the others.
Don't load a webfont, an external image, or any request beyond the payload's own API.
Don't add a third weight, italics, uppercase transforms or letter-spaced labels.
Don't animate anything except focus and the art cross-fade, and never longer than 240ms.
Don't make a destructive action solid, red or first in a row before its final confirmation step.
Don't depend on the Gamepad API or on buttons that were not measured on the console; arrow keys, a click and Escape are the whole input model.
